★ [[D-PP-SINGLE-PASS-INCLUDE-RESOLUTION]] — an include whose LIVENESS only a real macro expander can decide, as a RUNTIME witness. DSS resolves quote-#includes in a PRE-SCAN that runs before the authoritative macro pass (that pass needs one already-spliced buffer), so deciding which includes are live means evaluating #if — and the pre-scan used to do that with a PRIVATE evaluator that expanded OBJECT-LIKE macros only. Every guard it could not decide became a conservative SKIP: the header was never spliced and the macro pass REFUSED the program with `error[P0016]: quote #include "gate_a.h" is LIVE here but the include pre-scan could not evaluate its conditional guard, so the header was never spliced; refusing to silently drop it`. The pre-scan now drives the authoritative `MacroExpander` itself, hosted as an oracle over its own product tail, so both passes answer every #if with one implementation.
WHAT IS WITNESSED: this program DID NOT COMPILE before. A refused include is a hard error, not a miscompile, so there is no wrong-answer arm — the witness is that the artifact builds with zero diagnostics and RUNS to 42 through FOUR gates whose shapes the old evaluator could not decide, each contributing exactly one addend so that a gap in any ONE takes the whole program down: gate_a.h behind `#if ENABLED(1)` (a FUNCTION-LIKE macro in the guard, the shape the row names); gate_b.h behind `#if GATE` where GATE is an OBJECT-like macro expanding TO a call (the old evaluator had a SECOND, separate bail for this, because freezing an unexpandable identifier is only safe at even polarity); gate_c.h behind `#if CAT(ON,E)` (a `##` PASTE, which a rescan-only expander cannot perform at all); and gate_d.h through a COMPUTED `#include HDR(gate_d.h)` (C23 6.10.2p4 — the same weakness through a different arm, and one the row did not name). 10+11+9+12 = 42, with each addend also checked individually so a compensating pair cannot reach 42 by accident, plus a real function DEFINITION in each header whose duplicate would fail the link if a header were spliced twice.
★★★ THE FIFTH GATE IS THE ONE THAT MUST NOT FIRE, and it is what keeps this example from rewarding the wrong fix. `#if ENABLED(0)` guards an `#include` of a header that DOES NOT EXIST, twice — once bare and once as the dead arm of a group whose `#else` IS taken. C 6.10p1 makes a dead branch's directives unprocessed, so a pre-scan that became EAGER rather than CORRECT — resolving the include because it could not decide the guard — fails to compile this file at all. That is P0016 (D-PP-CONDITIONAL-INCLUDE-ORDERING) itself, the defect the conservative direction existed to prevent.
★★ REFERENCE GROUND TRUTH, NOT DSS'S OPINION, each probed SEPARATELY 2026-09-03: WSL gcc 13.3.0, WSL clang 18.1.3 and mingw-w64 gcc 13.2.0 all compile this under `-std=c17 -Wall -Wextra` with no diagnostics and all three binaries independently exit 42; MSVC 19.51.36252 accepts it under `cl /nologo /c /std:c17 /W3` (exit 0, front-end only — no vcvars needed for a preprocessor question). The union is UNANIMOUS, so `DSS = (gcc ∪ clang ∪ MSVC) ∪ ISO C` REQUIRES it. The `release` arm runs the shipped parser->semantic->codegen->native pipeline over the same source, so it also witnesses that the optimizer does not disturb the spliced result.
